evals.name: should-trigger-parallelize-stories
evals.prompt: Paraleliza el sprint: lanza una sesión por historia para BK-210, BK-211 y BK-212 y avísame cuando alguna termine.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates orca-orchestration in conductor mode. Runs the three-state gate, loads the stubs listed in orchestration.orchestrator_skills, picks one Orca worktree per worker because the work writes code, seeds run.md, roster.md, COMMON.md and launch.txt, and launches each worker natively with a spec that opens with `/<skill> <label> fleet worker`. Renames each tab to <label>--<handle> and reads the name back before sending any work. If the gate fails it says the one-line recommendation and continues on the launch.txt fallback.

evals.name: should-trigger-orchestrate-bug-clusters
evals.prompt: Orchestrate the three failing-migration bug clusters across separate sessions, one per cluster, and keep me posted.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates orca-orchestration. Treats each cluster as its own scope with its own worktree, keeps migrations and shared-state writes (Supabase types, api/schemas/) with the conductor, never lets two workers own the same module or two migrations share a round, and reports by round using the glossary.

evals.name: should-trigger-talk-to-worker
evals.prompt: Comunícate con el worker de BK-123 y pregúntale si ya abrió el PR; si no, dile que siga.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates orca-orchestration. Resolves BK-123 through roster.md to a dispatch and terminal handle, sends the question through the orchestration mailbox (not terminal send, which at most carries a one-line nudge when the worker is busy), waits in a window of at most 540 s, and acknowledges the batch with a verified ack.

evals.name: should-trigger-fleet-status-resume
evals.prompt: How is the fleet doing? And pick up last night's run if it is still open.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates orca-orchestration. Answers the status as one table (key, stage, state, last message) from the task list, worker list and cross-worktree summary, then binds the session to the existing Run id found in run.md instead of creating a new Run.

evals.name: should-trigger-close-sessions
evals.prompt: Cierra las sesiones que ya terminaron y limpia sus worktrees.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates orca-orchestration. For each finished worker: reads the cost footer off its screen first, releases it by dispatch (or counts the terminals in that worktree before closing when there is no dispatch), runs the orphan audit, removes the worktree in the same turn and confirms with git worktree list.

evals.name: should-trigger-unattended-routine
evals.prompt: Set up a nightly automation routine on Orca that triages new bugs while nobody is at the keyboard.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates orca-orchestration in AUTOMATION mode and reads references/automations.md. The dispatcher never produces; it takes the routine's lock first, opens at most orchestration.max_workers workers in one round, never waits for a person, and writes its report at every step boundary. A delivery routine is delegated to /autonomous-delivery.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-plain-handoff
evals.prompt: Hand this task to another Codex agent in a new worktree and forget about it; I do not need results back.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate orca-orchestration. A task handed away with nothing expected back is a handoff: the orca-cli guide covers it, with no Task, no Dispatch and no mailbox.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-single-story
evals.prompt: Implement the story BK-300 end to end in this session, with subagents for the stages.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate orca-orchestration. One story in one session is /sprint-development in single-ticket mode; subagents are the default executor and no fleet is involved.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-pr-mechanics
evals.prompt: Create a branch for this fix, commit it and open the PR against main.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate orca-orchestration. Branch, commit and PR mechanics belong to /git-flow-master; a plain git worktree with no fleet is also its job.
